text: In Java, `int[][]` is a genuine two-dimensional array laid out as one contiguous block.
explanation: It is an array of references to arrays, so the rows are separate objects that may be different lengths and may live anywhere in memory. That has two consequences: ragged arrays are natural rather than a special feature, and row-major traversal is fast while column-major is slow, because each row is contiguous but the rows are not contiguous with each other. Chapter 32 measures the resulting threefold difference.
